lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four to five horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with a higher spatial frequency observed in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of diffuse, elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like alignment of anchor nodes particularly visible in the anterior section of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature running horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a distinct luminance transition from high-intensity reflection on the dorsal edge to a shadow-cast gradient on the ventral edge.
